lineas.texto: How many people left your waiting room today without being served?
This clinic got rid of the line at its door with one screen and a QR code.
Still booking appointments in a notebook? This is for you.
Long lines, people who don't know when it's their turn, and appointments nobody confirms. All of that costs you customers.
With Turnero, your customer takes a number, sees it on the screen in your place, and your team calls the next one with a single click, in real time.
And if you work by appointment, the booking system lets people book from your website, confirms on its own, and can ask for a deposit so nobody stands you up.
Try the free demo, or message us and we'll adapt it to your business.
